dashboard.title: Control Panel
dashboard.syncing: Scanning local network and syncing statistics...
dashboard.no_devices: You don't have any registered devices yet.
dashboard.empty_ecosystem_desc: Scan the network to discover devices

unlink.title: Unlink device?
unlink.confirm_text: {{name}} will be deleted from the local database. You can add it back from the network scanner.
unlink.warning: This action only deletes the local record. The physical device will not be affected.

device_details.no_dps: No Data Points detected. Is the device physically disconnected?
device_details.offline_msg: The device is not available on the network. Check if it is plugged in and connected to WiFi.
device_details.upload_error: Upload error. Use JPG, PNG or SVG under 2MB.

scan.title: Network Scanner

port_conflict.title: Port conflict detected
port_conflict.desc: Tuya needs ports 6666, 6667, 7000 to scan the network. Another application is using them.
port_conflict.how_to_solve: How do you want to resolve the conflict?

auto_close.title: Close apps automatically
auto_close.desc: Our program will close the listed apps and retry.

manual.title: I'll do it myself
manual.desc: Close the apps manually and scan again.

confirm_kill.title: Confirm force close?
confirm_kill.desc: {{count}} process{{suffix}} ({{names}}) will be closed. Make sure to save your work in those applications before continuing.

killing.title: Closing processes...
killing.desc: Waiting for the system to release the ports.

port_conflict.error_failed_pids: Could not close processes with PID: {{pids}}. Try closing them manually.

scan.scan_desc: Search for new smart devices on your WiFi or Zigbee network to pair them with your ecosystem.
scan.scan_advice: Make sure your Tuya devices are powered on and connected to your current local network.
scan.error_pair_fallback: Failed retrieving keys from the Tuya cloud.
scan.error_invalid_id: Device has no valid ID for pairing.

comm_fail.title: Could not connect to "{{name}}"
comm_fail.detail: Something went wrong with the communication with the Tuya server. This can happen occasionally.
comm_fail.hint: Wait a few seconds and try again. If the error continues, restart the application.

config_fail.title: Application not configured
config_fail.detail: SmartControl needs to be connected to your Tuya account to pair devices.
config_fail.hint: Contact the application administrator to configure access credentials.

no_conn.title: No connection
no_conn.detail: Could not contact the server. Check if you have WiFi or if the application is correctly started.
no_conn.hint: Close and reopen the application and ensure you are connected to the same network as your devices.

not_linked.title: "{{name}}" is not linked to your account
not_linked.detail: The device is on your local network but does not appear in your Tuya account. It may be associated with another account.
not_linked.hint: Open the official Tuya app and check if this device appears in your device list.

tuya_reject.title: Tuya server rejected the request
tuya_reject.detail: The Tuya platform did not accept the operation. This may be temporary or indicate a permission issue.
tuya_reject.hint: Wait a few minutes and try again. If the problem persists, try logging out and back in to the Tuya app.

timeout.title: "{{name}}" took too long to respond
timeout.detail: The device is taking longer than expected. it may be busy or have a weak WiFi signal.
timeout.hint: Move the device closer to the router and try again.

generic.title: Could not pair "{{name}}"
generic.detail: An unexpected error occurred while trying to connect to this device.
generic.hint: Try again in a few seconds. If the error repeats multiple times, restart the device from its physical switch.

scan.title: Bluetooth Manager
scan.advice: Ensure the device is paired with Windows and powered on.

controls.title: Audio Control Panel
controls.select_device: Select a device to manage its volume
controls.no_session: No active multimedia session detected in the system.

analysis.title: Live Analysis
analysis.subtitle: Monitor hardware events and metrics in real time

statistics.title: Global Statistics
statistics.subtitle: Visualize battery and status history for all your devices

settings.title: System Settings
settings.subtitle: Manage your Tuya credentials and security preferences
settings.mode_simple_desc: Use the system keys provided by the developer. Ideal for home users.
settings.mode_advanced_desc: Use your own Tuya IoT Platform keys. Requires a developer account.
settings.security_notice: Your keys are stored encrypted using your Operating System's security technology.
settings.terms_text: By using Simple Mode, you agree that developer credentials will be used for communication with Tuya Cloud. We do not collect your private keys, but the service depends on the validity of these system credentials.
settings.accept_terms: I accept the terms and want to use Simple Mode
